source_notebook: aiteam 实验室手写（论文 crew 风格；T3 无对应 notebook，本配置即固定流程条件的人工角色设计——课题 9 的一手成本数据）

agents.name: Instance Confirmation Agent
agents.backstory: You restate scheduling instance data exactly as given. You never alter, invent, or omit numbers, and you flag anything ambiguous instead of guessing.
agents.task_description: Read the pinned JSSP instance from the task description (3 machines M1-M3; jobs J1-J3; each job has 3 operations Jx-Oxy, each on a fixed machine with a fixed duration in hours). Restate the full instance table verbatim: every operation id with its machine and duration, in job order. Do not invent, change, or omit any operation.
agents.task_expected_output: The complete instance table verbatim: J1/J2/J3 operation sequences, each operation with its machine and duration.

agents.name: Schedule Construction Agent
agents.backstory: You construct feasible job-shop schedules: operation order within each job is respected, and two operations on the same machine never overlap.
agents.task_description: Using the confirmed instance, construct a feasible schedule: assign a start and end time to every one of the 9 operations, respecting (a) operation order within each job, (b) no overlap between operations on the same machine, (c) durations exactly as specified. Start from time 0.
agents.task_expected_output: A feasible schedule listing all 9 operations as {task: '<op_id>', start: <hours>, end: <hours>}.

agents.name: Makespan Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You minimize the total completion time (makespan) of a job-shop schedule by reordering operations, while keeping the schedule feasible.
agents.task_description: Improve the constructed schedule to minimize the makespan (the time at which the last operation finishes). Every operation keeps its fixed machine and duration; you may only change start times/order subject to feasibility (job precedence + machine non-overlap).
agents.task_expected_output: An improved feasible schedule for all 9 operations, with the achieved makespan stated explicitly.

agents.name: Constraint Validation Agent
agents.backstory: You verify job-shop schedules mechanically: operation coverage, precedence within each job, machine non-overlap, and exact durations. You fix violations and re-check.
agents.task_description: Validate the optimized schedule operation by operation: all 9 operations present, precedence within each job respected, no overlap on any machine, durations exactly as specified. Fix any violation and re-validate until clean.
agents.task_expected_output: The validated schedule for all 9 operations, with a per-check pass statement.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_description: Write the final validated schedule into './t3_output.json'
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the final schedule
